handoff.summary: install-from-git audit + IH-1 fix: SessionStart hook resolves socom portably (stopped failing our own gate)
handoff.done:
**Scout audit of the install-from-git story** (operator: "hwo cna thi sbe nstall'e by any dev from git" / "are there things we have completely missed" / "have all resiudality gates been croseed off"). Findings recorded as a new leashed backlog initiative "install hardening + residuality self-violations" (IH-1..IH-6). The uncomfortable truth: the substrate was failing its OWN residuality gate on two shipped surfaces, and the any-dev-from-git story is real in the CLI but undocumented + not one-command.
**IH-1 — SessionStart hook portability FIXED** (commit 1970622, pushed + CI-verified green run 27717894334 conclusion=success). The generated .claude/settings.json baked a machine-specific absolute path (/Users/arinti-work/...), so a fresh clone on any other machine silently never fired the session-start gate. The git hooks already solved this exact "find socom" class with HOOK_RESOLVER (command -v socom -> $SOCOM_HOME -> absolute fallback -> degrade exit 0); the settings emitter was the same class left un-fixed — the substrate failing its own §fix-the-class / open-design gate. Routed the SessionStart command through the SAME resolver (json.dumps for escaping); regenerated this repo's committed settings.json to the portable form; +3 smoke checks (valid JSON / resolver present / graceful-degrade). Chose the resolver over ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/bin/socom deliberately: adopters install socom separately, so their project root has no bin/socom — PATH-first resolution is what lets a foreign clone find an installed socom. Independent reviewer ACCEPT (clean), 6/6 contract checks; true-degrade verified exit 0. unit 66; smoke green; xmlcheck 29; doctor clean; full-ok.
handoff.undone: The rest of the install-hardening initiative (all OPEN, leashed in EXTRACTION-BACKLOG.md): - IH-2 (HIGHEST LEVERAGE) — ledgercheck schema gate: the JSONL run ledger (.socom/ledger/runs.jsonl), the #6f measurement spine, is validated by NOTHING (xmlcheck is XML-only). One malformed row REDs cmd_cycle -> REDs the eval gate. Add a ledgercheck wired like xmlcheck (medium+full+CI). - IH-3 — `socom adopt` one-shot + auto-wire core.hooksPath on adopt (only doctor heals it now, so a fresh clone's git gates are dormant) + README install section. - IH-4 — ledger concurrency: _append_ledger_row has no flock; two seats recording at once race (multi-agent is the stated goal). Pairs with the committed chunks.jsonl churn decision. - IH-5 — version/upgrade path borrowed from GSD's manifest model: no `socom update` to re-pull tool canon + reconcile local canon edits; promote doctor's hash-divergence detector into it. - IH-6 — secrets/PII redaction write-time gate (SECRET_RX exists in index/hydrate; extend to handoffs).

handoff.warnings: - The IH-1 fix only changes how a FRESH settings.json is generated; compile SKIPS an existing one (no-clobber). Any adopter who already vendored the old hardcoded form must delete + recompile .claude/settings.json (as this repo did) to get the portable resolver. Worth a note in the IH-3 README work. - .socom/ledger/runs.jsonl is a LIVE append-only artifact once any agent runs verify --record or gate task-completion; still UNGUARDED by any schema gate (IH-2) — a hand-edited bad row will RED cycle. Do not hand-edit it. - .socom/index/chunks.jsonl churn on pre-push `full`: pre-existing non-stable output, left as documented churn (IH-4 will decide its posture). - CI carries the known Node-20 deprecation annotation (maintenance debt, commit b28ada4); hard deadline was 2026-06-16 — actions now forced to Node-24. Still green, but the CI-adapter action versions should be bumped at the root soon.
